summary: Iter91 — Work Dashboard PRD (My Work vs Team Monitor split; Responsibility Gap fully removed). (no gap row), My Work section only exposes super_admin_only work (currently 0 open so shows empty state), Team Monitor shows operational team work (Tiket Bantuan/Proses Add-on). /admin/work as Super Admin: no work-gap-alert, Konfigurasi dialog is SLA-only per work type with 'Khusus Super Admin' badge for sensitive_approval and no role toggle chips. release1 /admin/work shows Proses Rilisan and NOT Verifikasi Penarikan; finance1 /admin/work shows Verifikasi Penarikan and NOT Proses Rilisan. /admin/work/settings returns 'permission' key that may be None for sensitive_approval; frontend already conditions on scope==super_admin_only to show badge — no null-deref risk observed.
